verdict.rationale: Bland documents its own terminal CLI for managing the account, making calls, and building and testing pathways. It also offers a Pathways API for programmatic management and a plain-API agent flow that polls in the background, so headless automation is plausible. However, nothing documents CI pipelines, non-interactive or token-based auth for CI runners, or exit-code and scripting behavior. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, non-interactive CLI auth guidance, an OpenAPI spec (probe 404), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Manage your entire Bland account from the terminal: make calls, build and test pathways, configure phone numbers, and more.
See the Pathways API reference to create and manage pathways programmatically.
the bot starts the flow over a plain API call, shows its owner a short code and a link, and polls in the background while the owner finishes signup
